gauge.name: Tide Gauge on the Waccasassa River near Gulf Hammock (In MHHW)

dataAttribution.title: This link will lead you to the USGS gauge page

hydronotes.statement: Water levels are referenced to the Mean Higher High Water (MHHW) Datum. This datum can be used to approximate sea water inundation of normally dry ground near the coast. For specific impacts, please refer to the statements on this page.

value.label: Mean Higher High Water
value.description: The average of the higher high water height of each tidal day observed over the National Tidal Datum Epoch. For stations with shorter series, comparison of simultaneous observations with a control tide station is made in order to derive the equivalent datum of the National Tidal Datum Epoch.

gauge.forecastReliability: Graphical forecasts are not available during times of high water, forecast crest information can be found in the local WFO web page.
